component.name: MainScene
component.script: sub init() bar = m.top.findNode("player").trickPlayBar print "childCount: "; bar.getChildCount() ' jellyfin-roku reads the ticker as child 3 and the position Label as child 8. print "child3: "; bar.getChild(3).subtype() positionText = bar.getChild(8) print "child8: "; positionText.subtype(); " "; positionText.text positionText.text = "1:10" print "child8 after: "; bar.getChild(8).text print "child9: "; bar.getChild(9).subtype(); " "; bar.getChild(9).text end sub
